caption: The drawing depicts a round canteen with a narrow neck and a circular cap fastened by a short chain. Attached to the canteen is a wide strap that loops over the top and hangs down on either side; the strap appears textured and flexible. The canteen is oriented vertically, with the neck and cap at the top center of the image. There is a separate rectangular box drawn below the canteen, containing a sample texture representing the strap, accompanied by text indicating its length (5 ft. 5 in.), width (1 in.), and color (light tan). The entire drawing is rendered in pencil on a beige or light tan background. In the top right corner, there is handwritten text including the words “Canteen 1860-1865” and “Artist: Emilio Zito.” The depiction is detailed with emphasis on outlines and simple shading.
title: Canteen
